crossRefs.note: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on Yahweh’s name.

people.name: Enosh
people.line: Son of Seth, during whose time people called on the Lord's name.

people.name: Seth
people.line: Third son of Adam and Eve, ancestor of righteous line

translations.web: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.
translations.bsb: When Seth was 105 years old, he became the father of Enosh.
translations.kjv: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
translations.asv: And Seth lived a hundred and five years, and begat Enosh:
